response.justification: Bogdan possesses exceptional technical qualifications—expert-level TypeScript, React, Node.js, and full-stack capabilities demonstrated across 15+ years and multiple companies. However, his current Staff Engineer seniority at re:cinq creates significant misalignment with this junior/mid-level role, raising concerns about retention, career satisfaction, and genuine motivation. An interview is warranted only to clarify whether this represents an internal restructuring, specialized team assignment, or other context that justifies the dramatic seniority step-down.
strengths: Expert-level proficiency in all required technologies (TypeScript, React, Node.js) with proven full-stack delivery across complex domains and multiple organizations
Strong demonstrated commitment to software craftsmanship principles including TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture, and mentoring—core values for the role
Currently employed at re:cinq as Staff Engineer, providing immediate company and system knowledge while eliminating standard onboarding friction
concerns: Severe overqualification presents material risk of rapid job dissatisfaction, quick departure, and misaligned salary and career progression expectations
PostgreSQL experience not explicitly mentioned; resume shows MongoDB and general SQL background despite role preferring PostgreSQL expertise
Application of Staff-level engineer to junior/mid-level position at current employer raises unanswered questions about genuine interest and motivation for role
